0022600166.text: The Timberwolves (4-3) host the Bucks (1-5) in Minnesota's eighth game of the season. Minnesota is 9th in the West and coming off a loss, while Milwaukee has lost two straight and sits 14th in the East. Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery) are out for Minnesota, and Rudy Gobert is day-to-day with back spasms and a game-time decision. Minnesota won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 139-106 win in Milwaukee in their last meeting, and the two teams have not yet played each other in 2026-27.
